title: Neo4j After Dark at The Barbershop, with a live performance by almost monday
abstract: An exclusive night of live music, cocktails, and connection, hidden behind a speakeasy door on the Strip. Doors open at 7:00 pm with craft cocktails and chef-driven bites (the first 100 guests get a signed almost monday poster). At 7:30 pm, Neo4j's President and Chief Product Officer Sudhir Hasbe talks with Amit Sharma of 3M about why context is what makes AI work. From 8:00 to 10:00 pm, networking continues with a private set by almost monday, the band behind the Billboard Alternative Airplay #1 hit "can't slow down". Request a pass on the event page: space is limited, every request is reviewed, and a request isn't a confirmed pass. Bring your re:Invent badge and confirmation email.
